claim_policy: Definitions are not passing receipts. Tests must measure the exact claim.

checks.metric: events stored before opt-in; raw payload fields stored in metadata mode
managed merges without actual approval; advanced capabilities without acknowledgment
checks.required: denied by local cooperative gate; server enforcement tested separately

checks.metric: acknowledged unique events after reopen and concurrent writers
checks.required: 100% retained; stable append replay one effect; changed replay rejected

checks.metric: supported native fixture mappings and unsupported payload rejection
checks.required: all configured event names tested; no cross-harness guessing

checks.metric: exports misrepresented as complete conversations or automatically training-eligible
curated examples with base/task/action/observation/patch/test/review/outcome and rights records
checks.required: 100% before a curated release; not automatically implemented by capture

checks.metric: unreviewed secret/PII or unlicensed content in a curated dataset
checks.required: zero before release; raw archive remains restricted

checks.metric: reports claiming pushed/merged from only local Git facts
checks.required: zero; actual remote PR/main confirmation required
